about_the_game:
"Don't Breathe In" offers a thrilling survival-horror experience that traps you in a dark and dangerous laboratory. Your mission is to investigate the evacuated facility after a failed experiment caused an explosion while avoiding exposure to toxic gas. The only way out is to solve puzzles and find a way to escape the deadly atmosphere.

But remember: Every breath you take brings you closer to death...

🩸 Game Features:

✔ Psychological Horror & Thriller – Face a tense atmosphere, unexpected scares, and an unknown threat.
✔ Puzzle Solving & Exploration – Unlock doors and discover survival paths using your intelligence.
✔ Limited Resources – Your time and breath are restricted. Choose wisely, or you may never leave this lab.
✔ Dark & Atmospheric Graphics – A realistic horror experience with low lighting and an immersive sound design.

Can you survive? Or will this laboratory become your eternal grave?
